title: Uniting Blades and Blood in the Hallway — Part 5

series.summary: As Saeko and Nurse Shizuka advance through the lower corridors toward the faculty room, Saeko cautions that the reanimated dead possess overwhelming physical strength. Suddenly, the separate survivor groups collide in the central corridor, only to be encircled by an aggressive horde of zombies surging from both flanks. Forced into an immediate fight for their lives, the students coordinate instinctively: Saeko delivers bone-shattering strikes with her wooden sword, Takashi crushes oncoming attackers with his bat, Rei impales infected with her spear, and Kohta snipes flanking walkers with his nail gun. After slaughtering the swarm and securing the corridor, the six survivors catch their breath and introduce themselves. Overcome by the horror, Rei breaks down weeping for her mother, and the group rallies together in shared determination to reach the teachers' lounge and escape.

segments.voiceover_text: In the lower hallway, Saeko warns Nurse Shizuka that the infected possess monstrous physical strength. If the dead grab hold of you, escape is impossible.
Suddenly, all three survivor groups collide as an immense horde closes in from both flanks. Saeko shatters skulls with her bokken while Takashi bludgeons advancing attackers.
Rei drives her makeshift spear through an infected's skull while Kohta snipes charging walkers. Together, the six students completely eradicate the mob, securing the central corridor.
Catching their breath, Rei suddenly breaks down in tears, crying out for her mother. The survivors embrace her, realizing their survival depends on staying together.
